name: ST Product Review Generator
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
ST Product Review Generator adds a WooCommerce submenu that lets administrators quickly seed multiple products with realistic-looking reviews and star ratings. Choose categories or individual products, customize the names and review texts that will be used, control the rating range, and specify how many reviews to create per product.

Built-in safeguards ensure only administrators can run the generator, all requests are nonce protected, and the generated comments use standard WordPress APIs so they behave exactly like native WooCommerce reviews. Whether you’re preparing demo content or stress-testing storefront layouts, this plugin saves time compared to manual data entry.

Features

  • WooCommerce submenu page dedicated to review generation.
  • AJAX-powered product selector filtered by category.
  • Customizable lists of customer names and review bodies.
  • Control over start date, number of reviews, and rating bounds.
  • Generates approved WooCommerce reviews with rating and verified meta.
  • Respects WordPress capabilities, nonces, and sanitization best practices.

Usage

  1. Optionally select one or more product categories to limit which products appear.
  2. Select the target products using the AJAX-enabled product picker.
  3. Provide the list of customer names and review snippets (one per line).
  4. Choose the earliest review date, star rating range, and total reviews per product.
  5. Click Generate Reviews to seed the chosen products with new approved reviews.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/ or install it via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate ST Product Review Generator from the Plugins screen.
  3. Visit WooCommerce → ST Product Review Generator to configure and generate reviews.
sections.faq:
Who can run the generator?

Only users with the manage_options capability (normally Administrators) can access the tool and trigger review creation.

Can I undo generated reviews?

Reviews are standard WordPress comments with the type review. You can delete or moderate them later from the usual WooCommerce → Products → Reviews screen.

Is this safe to use on a live store?

The plugin is intended for demos and staging environments. Generated reviews use preset text and should not be used on production stores without clear disclosure.
